headline: Yanming (Owen) Dong surges to 29th on ARC-2

sections.text: Yanming (Owen) Dong gained 11.39 points to reach 41.25, leaping from 1,111th to 29th on the ARC-2 board.
That puts Dong among the leading challengers just outside the 15 gold places, with a much shorter climb now separating him from the medal group.
